name: Beast★Harem ~Yajuu no Amakami~
original_name: ビースト★ハーレム～野獣の甘噛み～
source:
The protagonist works as an office lady at your average company. During a high school friend's wedding, her life gets turned upside down by five hot and famous men. They invite her to a luxurious secret club called "~CLUB BEAST~". There, she's forced into playing pretend "hunts" with them.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150512230039/http://www.furyu.jp:80/mobile/otome/content_beast.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角是一家普通公司的女职员。在高中好友的婚礼上，五位英俊而知名的男人，彻底打乱了她的生活。他们邀请她前往一家奢华的秘密俱乐部“CLUB BEAST”，并在那里，迫使她与他们一起，玩起了模拟“狩猎”的游戏。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150512230039/http://www.furyu.jp:80/mobile/otome/content_beast.html]官方网站[/url]]
